title: Bayesian Deep Learning and Approximate Bayesian Computation for parameter inference
text: Recent advances deep learning offer promising solutions challenges (Baragatti et al. 2024). Neural networks can learn complex mappings high-dimensional summary statistics parameter spaces, effectively learning implicit likelihood posterior approximation. abcneuralnet package implements four state---art Bayesian deep learning approaches: Concrete Dropout: Provides rigorous uncertainty quantification approximate variational inference, specifically refinement “dropout variational Bayesian approximation” dropout rate learned inference (Gal, Hron, Kendall 2017; Baragatti et al. 2024) Monte Carlo Dropout: simpler “dropout” approach, offers uncertainty estimation stochastic forward passes, yet requiring careful tuning dropout rate hyper-parameter (Gal Ghahramani 2016) Deep Ensemble: highly efficient ensemble approach delivering robust predictions model averaging (Lakshminarayanan, Pritzel, Blundell 2016) TabNet-ABC: Combines interpretable attention mechanisms traditional ABC regression (Arik Pfister 2020; Åkesson et al. 2022) method addresses different aspects ABC inference problem, advantages limitations, maintaining compatibility existing ABC workflows providing rigorous uncertainty quantification essential scientific inference.
